name: NOAA West Coast VDatum model support for Offshore Monterey original depth

spatial.horizontal_crs: API source assumed NAD83_2011; target IGS14; original USGS NAD83 realization and epoch unresolved
spatial.vertical_datum: Conditional NAVD88 height to MLLW height at queried points

temporal.update_cadence: Monthly archive byte, API semantics and source-frame check

evidence.supports: NOAA lists California Monterey Bay to Morro Bay regional transformation grids, Version 03.
NOAA West Coast JSON API returns transformed height and vertical uncertainty with explicit source and target frames.
NOAA terms require attribution, disclose possible model mismatch and uncertainty, and do not warrant fitness for navigation.

limitations: The downloaded regional model ZIP SHA-256 is pinned, but an API response does not identify which ZIP version the service used.

Seventeen one-point outline probes conditionally assume NAD83(2011). The original USGS raster declares NAD83 without realization or coordinate epoch, so the probes cannot be applied to its native 2 m pixels.
The API-reported transformation uncertainty excludes the original USGS survey's measurement uncertainty, for which no per-cell upper bound has been established.
Model grid bounds contain nodata and are not proof of full candidate-polygon transformation coverage. No fishing coordinate or depth qualification is supported.

provenance.access_service: Official NOAA VDatum West Coast JSON API and regional grid archive
transformations: Verified original regional grid ZIP hash and metadata: IGS14, 1983-2001 tidal epoch, tidal release 2024-03-26.
Queried 17 bounded interior research-outline points with hypothetical NAD83(2011) NAVD88 zero-height input; saved exact URLs, response digests, offsets and API uncertainty in a research-only receipt.
Kept the source-realization, full-patch transform and USGS source-uncertainty gates closed; no source depth cell was converted or promoted.
